It was lacking tahini, chilli and/or yoghurt garlic sauces and the chicken meat seemed to have been fried and was rather tasteless. The flatbread was also quite doughy. It was certainly cheap. BTW we had seen old menus online that indicated they had hummus and other dips however they are no longer on the menu.

Well worth the visit if you're craving the non typical western or Vietnamese food usually offered.
Sep 2023 • Couples
Mui Me was pretty much a ghost town when we visited, and yet somehow, this place was busy.
We had the beef doner and shish tavouk.
Not bad, their cajik could use a little more garlic, and the side salad could be larger.
We came back for dinner and had the shwarma. They were better than the doner and larger sizes.
I'm giving 5 stars because this was the best of the food we have had in the area...but it would probably rate it more harshly if there were better options around.
Oh and this is order and pay at the counter, then they bring their food to you.
It's not waiter service, so discount those bad reviews you read about that.
